description.en-US: Shared by character rendering and wallpaper surfaces.
description.zh-CN: 角色渲染和壁纸画面共用这些设置。

label.zh-CN: 标准 · 60 FPS，原生像素密度

label.en-US: Power saving · 30 FPS, up to 1.5× pixel density
label.zh-CN: 节能 · 30 FPS，像素密度最高 1.5×

description.en-US: Choose animation smoothness and GPU load. Custom values are preserved when using a preset.
description.zh-CN: 按动画流畅度与 GPU 负载选择预设；切换预设不会清除自定义数值。

description.en-US: 10–240 FPS. This is a ceiling, not a guaranteed frame rate.
description.zh-CN: 范围 10–240 FPS。这是上限，不代表实际能达到的帧率。

description.en-US: 0.25–4.0×, capped by the display’s native pixel density. Lower values reduce GPU work but may soften the image.
description.zh-CN: 范围 0.25–4.0×，不超过显示器原生像素密度。调低可减少 GPU 负载，但画面可能变模糊。
